name: Sonos
author: Pieter
description: Control the Sonos speakers on your network from the bar: now playing, play/pause, skip, volume, TV input, Night Sound and Speech Enhancement, and one-click Sonos Favorites. Talks only to players on the local network (UPnP, port 1400); no Sonos account or cloud. Polls the players every few seconds.

barWidget.description: Sonos controller: now playing, volume, home-theatre settings and favorites. Middle-click plays/pauses, right-click mutes, scroll changes volume.

schema.label: Preferred room
schema.description: Room to show when several are available. Leave empty to follow whichever is playing.

schema.label: Volume step
schema.description: How much one scroll notch changes the volume.

schema.label: Background refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar icon checks the speakers while the panel is closed. The open panel refreshes every 2 seconds.
